# uptrace_alertmanager_channel (Resource)

Manages an Uptrace Alertmanager notification channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_project" "example" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "api"
}

resource "uptrace_alertmanager_channel" "basic_auth" {
  project_id  = uptrace_project.example.id
  name        = "alerts-alertmanager-basic"
  priorities  = ["high"]
  url         = "https://alertmanager.example.com/api/v2/alerts"
  auth_method = "basic_auth"
  username    = "probe"
  password    = "probe-secret"
}

resource "uptrace_alertmanager_channel" "bearer" {
  project_id  = uptrace_project.example.id
  name        = "alerts-alertmanager-bearer"
  priorities  = ["high"]
  url         = "https://alertmanager.example.com/api/v2/alerts"
  auth_method = "bearer"
  token       = "alertmanager-bearer-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable channel name.
- `priorities` (List of String) Alert priorities to match. Valid values: info, low, medium, high.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID this channel belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.
- `url` (String) Alertmanager API endpoint URL.

### Optional

- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method: none, basic_auth, or bearer.
- `condition` (String) Alert condition expression.
- `match_all` (Boolean) Match all monitors. If false, monitor_ids must be provided.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitor IDs to match when match_all is false.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for basic_auth.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token for bearer auth.
- `username` (String) Username for basic_auth.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `status` (String) Channel status (delivering, paused, disabled, draft).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_alertmanager_channel.basic_auth 1:42
```
